title: Other
intro: *Other* gathers work that extends beyond the installation and the image plane: art in architecture, publications, curatorial and collaborative projects. These formats situate the same research-driven practice within public, institutional, and discursive contexts—where systems and processes are negotiated not only as material configurations but as spatial commissions, shared authorship, and printed matter. Across scales, the concern remains constant: to make structural and processual conditions legible, and to test them in the specific situations where they take effect.
